welcome.title: Forward Your SMS to Email
welcome.body: Incoming SMS are delivered to the email you verify with a one-time code. Message contents are not stored on the server.
welcome.warning: SMS often contain bank and verification codes. Use this only for your own phone and your own email.
email.title: Email
email.error: Could not send the code. Try again.
otp.title: Enter the 6-digit code sent to your email
otp.error: Could not verify the code. Try again.
perm.title: SMS permission
perm.sms.explain: To forward SMS we need permission to read incoming messages. They are only sent to your own email.
perm.denied: Permission was denied. SMS permission is required to forward messages.

home.error.smtp_failed: The email could not be sent.
home.error.unauthorized: Your session expired. Sign in again.
